definitions.explanation: The act of adding a substance to something, typically in a technical, industrial, or food science context. Most commonly refers to adding chemicals, preservatives, flavoring, or other substances to food or products.

examples.japanese: {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{入|はい}っていない→入る：00494_hairu⟧。
⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{安全性|あんぜんせい}→安全性：19384_anzensei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧になっている。
examples.english: The safety of food additives has become an issue.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}→着色料：19751_chakushokuryou⟧や⟦{保存料|ほぞんりょう}→保存料：06593_hozonryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{添加|てんか}⟦していません→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: No artificial coloring or preservatives have been added to this product.

notes:
USAGE:
Most commonly encountered in the compound {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ} (additive), especially ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ} (food additive). This is by far the most frequent context for this word.

Not to be confused with the homophone ⟦{天下|てんか}→天下：12188_tenka⟧ (the world, the realm).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}: additive
- ⟦{食品|しょくひん}→食品：03247_shokuhin⟧{添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}: food additive
- {無|む}{添加|てんか}: additive-free, no additives
- {添加|てんか}{物|ぶつ}⟦{不使用|ふしよう}→不使用：29835_fushiyou⟧: no additives used
- {添加|てんか}⟦{剤|ざい}→〜剤：30790_zai⟧: additive agent
